plain: Let the judge decide the cases it scores as clearly pass or clearly fail, and send the unsure middle to a person or a stronger grader.
eli5: The easy ones you mark yourself; the tricky ones go to the teacher.
technical: Selective prediction with abstention: two thresholds on the judge's score define auto-pass, auto-fail and escalate bands. It works only if the score is calibrated; set the band on dev, check per-band accuracy on test, and audit all bands.
